Walter S. Judd (born 1951) was an American botanist and taxonomist , and distinguished professor in the Department of Botany, University of Florida beginning in 2009. [ 1 ] Judd was born in Fairbanks, Alaska; his family relocated to Shiawassee CO, Michigan. Due to the rural setting, it inspired him to study natural history, botany, plant taxonomy and systematics, and phylogenetics. [ 2 ]
